notes: EDGE CASE: a neighborhood 'market recap' that name-drops a specific building and a recent closing price as a data point, which risks being misread as an ACTIVE_SALE_LISTING or PRICE_DROP. It is still informational commentary (recap of closed comps and trends), not a listing being offered -> MARKET_REPORT. Grade category + themes + confidence only; deliberately omit price/address (the numbers are cited comps, not an offer). Lower confidence floor.

input.subject: Park Slope closed-comps recap — where prices actually landed this summer
input.bodyText:
Quick summer recap for my Park Slope-watching clients and colleagues — this is market commentary, nothing for sale here.

What actually closed:
- Brownstones on the numbered streets traded 4-6% under initial ask on average
- A 2BR at 300 Garfield Pl closed at $1.42M after 71 days (asked $1.55M)
- Well-renovated 3BRs still moving fast; unrenovated sitting
- Bidding wars are back only under $1.2M

Takeaway: price it right the first time. Full comp sheet available on request.

Sofia Reyes
Compass
